learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about shiny coins, colorful notes, and how to buy fun things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use money to buy things we like. Money comes in small round coins and colorful paper notes. Every coin and note has a magic number on it!
When we want a toy, we give money to the shopkeeper. If a ball is for 5 rupees, we give a 5 rupee coin!
Sometimes we buy two things! We just add the numbers together. A 2 rupee pencil and a 2 rupee eraser make 4 rupees.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Little Toy Shop
fun_activity.instructions: Put your favorite toys on a table and make small paper price tags for them. Use play money or draw your own coins to play shopping with your family!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use rupee coins and notes to buy yummy snacks and toys.
⭐ We can count and add our money together to see how much we can spend!
